note: FNS 753 is a QC review procedure directing reviewers to exclude variances for elements where verification was postponed in expedited service cases. The section specifies conditions under which QC reviewers should not count postponed-verification variances as errors — this is audit methodology, not caseworker policy. The underlying caseworker policy that FNS 753 depends on (identity is the only verification required within 7 days; other verifications may be postponed; postponed items must be documented) IS covered in the OLG across multiple pages: 'Expedited Benefits' (Step Two: identity-only requirement, lack of other verification must not delay expedited service), 'Issuing Expedited Benefits' (same rules with examples), and the VC-1 process (BEACON generates a single verification checklist separating expedited identity verification from other postponed items, providing the documentation trail). The OLG appropriately covers the caseworker-facing requirements without needing to address QC variance exclusion rules.
